name: Jack – tuned boosting + red-flag features

validation.description: Last 2,000 training transactions (31 Jul - 31 Aug 2026), held out

notes: Gradient boosting with smaller, slower-learning trees plus red-flag combinations (unknown device x failed logins, abroad without travel notice, transfer to new payee, round £100 amounts). Across 4 time-based test blocks (late May - Aug): 3,925 points vs 3,795 for the original settings.
